quote:「それでいい。\\n それでこそだよ」.en:
「Good.
 That is just as it should be.」

quote:「ば、馬鹿な！\\n こんな事はあってはならない事だ！」.en:
「I-Impossible!
 Such a thing must not be!」

quote:「やるじゃん！\\n 次に会う時も楽しませてよね！」.en:
「Not bad!
 Show me a good time next time too!」

quote:「…君は次に会った時、必ず死ぬ…。\\n 僕が必ず殺す…！」.en:
「...Next time we meet, you're dead...
 I'll kill you myself...!」

quote:「いはやは、やりますなぁ…。\\n ここは退散させていただきます」.en:
「Dear me, you're quite good...
 Allow me to beat a retreat here.」

quote:「ぬううっ！\\n この汚名を雪ぐ機会を必ずや…！」.en:
「Nngh!
 I swear I'll clear my name...!」

uncertain: quote 244 (Code: White) 「隊長！　私達を…！」 trails off with no verb; rendered 'Please... save us...!' from her final-stage pleas to Advent (dlg_2099_13); the verb is inferred.
quote 227 (Advent) それでこそだよ read as approval of the player's strength: 'That is just as it should be.'
quote 237 (Sardias): the Japanese has いはやは (typo for いやはや), rendered 'Dear me'.
quote 248 (Firebug member) 姫 rendered 'Princess'; who the Firebug men mean is not confirmed.
report.notes: Names written out from the glossary: Code: Blue, Code: White. Voices matched to voice groups g031/g032 (Advent), g177 (Doctrine), g065 (Elunaluna), g164 (Dabalan), g209 (Barbiel), g127 (Sardias), g092 (Girtar), g059 (Australis/Vildark), g117/g118 (Blue/White).
